summary: James River Group Holdings filed an 8-K containing its first-quarter 2026 earnings release and a declaration of a $0.01 per share cash dividend. The filing includes financial results (net loss of $0.23 per diluted share from continuing ops, adjusted net operating income of $0.12 per share) and standard dividend mechanics. There are no special situation elements—no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The dividend is a routine capital allocation decision, not a special return of capital event. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement with no special situation implications.
